findings.evidence: Monoidal/Cup.lean:290 `d_comp_cupCochain`, :300 `cupCochain_naturality`, :507 `cup_naturality` are all stated for a general `D`; Cup.lean:282 `singularCup_naturality` is a one-line specialization. The proof at Cup.lean:201-217 uses only the evaluation formula plus `subinterval_comp_subinterval` and an associator computation — i.e. exactly coassociativity of the diagonal — and Cup.lean:311-318 re-does by hand the homologyπ/iCycles descent that `cup_naturality` already performs generically.
findings.fix: Add `TauCeti.ChainComplex.cupCochain_assoc`/`cup_assoc` in TauCeti/Algebra/Homology/Monoidal/Cup.lean with the chain-level hypothesis `D ≫ D₁₂ ▷ A₃ ≫ (α_ ..).hom = D' ≫ A₁ ◁ D₂₃` and `hμ` (needs one new lemma relating `tensorCochain` across the ChainComplex associator); then prove `TopCat.alexanderWhitneyDiagonal` coassociative from `hu` (this is where `subinterval_comp_subinterval` belongs) and derive the two current lemmas from it.
findings.issue: `cupCochain_alexanderWhitneyDiagonal_assoc` (and `singularCup_assoc`, :300) state associativity only for `X.alexanderWhitneyDiagonal`, while the general file proves every other law of `cupCochain`/`cup` for an arbitrary diagonal `D : E ⟶ A ⊗ B` (`d_comp_cupCochain`, `cupCochain_naturality`, `cup_naturality`). The only input about the space is that the diagonal is coassociative; stated here, the reusable statement (coassociativity of the AW diagonal) never appears, and the relative/twisted/local-coefficient cup products of roadmap Stage 6 item 2 would have to redo the whole argument.

findings.evidence: Basic.lean:144 `Cofan.IsColimit.desc ((toSSet.obj X).isColimitChainComplexXCofan R 0)`; `isColimitChainComplexXCofan` is Mathlib's SSet-level API (mathlib/Mathlib/AlgebraicTopology/SimplicialSet/Homology/Basic.lean:115). The repo already keeps the simplicial-set-level content separate (`SSet.alexanderWhitney`, SimplicialSet/AlexanderWhitney.lean:196, with the TopCat wrapper in Singular/AlexanderWhitney.lean:54), and chains of other simplicial sets are already used (Singular/Subdivision/Small/Homotopy.lean:55).
findings.fix: State them for `K : SSet.{w}` (`SSet.constCochain K e`, `ιChainComplex_constCochain`, `d_comp_constCochain`) with the identical proofs, and keep `constSingularCocycle`/`iCycles_constSingularCocycle` at the `TopCat` level on top of them.
findings.issue: `constSingularCochain`, `ιChainComplex_constSingularCochain` (:148) and `d_comp_constSingularCochain` (:155) are bound to `X : TopCat` but mention `X` only through `toSSet.obj X`; every ingredient and the whole proof are statements about an arbitrary simplicial set, so the declarations are less general than their content.

summary: Associativity is proved one level too low: the general cup-product file already carries the diagonal-generic Leibniz and naturality laws, but associativity is stated only for the Alexander–Whitney diagonal of a space, hiding the reusable theorem (coassociativity of that diagonal). The constant 0-cochain is likewise bound to TopCat although its definition and proof use only the underlying simplicial set.
